Dear Sir/Madam, 
 
Pursuant to Regulation 30 and Part A of Schedule III of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure 
Requirements) Regulations 2015, we wish to inform you that, we have scheduled the Conference Call 
to be hosted by Motilal Oswal Financial Services Limited, on Wednesday, November 04, 2026,  
at 11.00 a.m. IST to discuss the Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended on 
September 30, 2026, with the Management of the Company. 
 
The detailed schedule of the conference call is attached herewith for your information and records. 
 
Kindly acknowledge receipt of the same. 
 
Yours truly,
